jobs.name: Fern
jobs.prompt: Rune Rumble: Arcade Aura interface plus Ink & Motion effects. Midnight purple with vivid cyan, coral pink, amber and acid lime accents. Clear pixel art with deliberate hard pixel clusters and confident silhouettes, richer character detail. Preserve the referenced fighter's face, hair, hat, outfit, skin tone, colors and proportions. Avoid wood ornaments, crystal shard decoration, rune glyph decoration, glossy mobile-game bevels, smooth vector rendering and blurry painted pixels. Supporting identity reference: the attached existing tiny gameplay character. Create a NEW much larger and more detailed PIXEL ART character-selection animation sheet for Fern. Exactly FOUR equal cells arranged 2 columns by 2 rows on a transparent 1536x1536 canvas, each cell 768x768. Each cell has the same full fighter from head to boots, facing slightly right in a relaxed combat stance, visible eyes and detailed layered clothing. Occupy 85% of cell height, consistent identical foot position, body proportions and camera, empty gutters. Sequential breathing loop: frame1 relaxed exhaled, frame2 shoulders and chest gently rising, frame3 softly inhaled with parted mouth catching breath, frame4 lowering back to relaxed. Subtle arm/cloth/hair follow through. No attack, weapon effects, labels, borders, extra characters, shadows beneath feet or background. Genuine pixel-art animation, no smooth anime illustration.
